Anthropic’s newest model can work all weekend without you. Getting the most out of it means changing how you work.

Fable 5.2 is out today, and it’s built for jobs too big to babysit. Our testers handed it projects that ran overnight—and sometimes all weekend—and got back work they’ll keep using, including a professional-grade video editor one of our engineers built in three days. The tradeoff is that it’s slow, and it’s hungry for tokens.

Our full Vibe Check gets into:

 * What happened when frontier team member Kieran Klaassen https://every.?ev_audience=free let Fable build his own video editor
 * How head of evals Mike Taylor https://every.?ev_audience=free used Fable to turn scattered Slack conversations and meeting notes into an explainer video
 * Why the highest effort settings often made things worse

The full review will help you decide whether you have a job big enough for it.
